design.repeatedWork: All flattened edge pairs previously tested even when vertical intervals cannot overlap.
design.endState: Flatten unique shapes, then reuse existing Crossing[] to sort minimum-Y/original-index intervals. Test only later starts below the current maximum-Y. Preserve original edge-index orientation and intersection arithmetic; sort/deduplicate final events. Scan conversion subsequently owns the same crossing storage.
design.correctness: No change to subdivision, intersection values, winding, polygon clipping, coverage accumulation, final rounding, exact composition, glyph order or public boundaries. No cache, new array/comparer or production dependency.
design.tradeoff: Ordering incurs additional sort/delegate allocations and crossing storage overlaps event preparation. Preserve measured gains while disclosing the small allocation/admitted-peak increase; total allocation is not physical peak.
